user.title: Network
user.description: The Zhongshan Water portal ([smartbi.zsws.com.cn]({portal_url})) resolves to an unreachable IPv6 address on some networks, which shows up as a connect timeout. If login keeps failing, come back here and pick "IPv4 only".

credentials.title: Sign in to Zhongshan Water
credentials.description:
Sign in with your portal account (or open the [web portal]({portal_url})).

Enter your **phone number** and **password**. Submitting sends an SMS code to that number; the next screen asks for the code to finish signing in.

sms_code.title: Enter the SMS code
sms_code.description:
A code was sent to **{mobile}**. Enter it below.

The password is only checked at this point, so a wrong password also shows up here. If no code arrives, go back one step and submit again.

no_account.title: No 户号 bound yet
no_account.description:
Signed in, but this account has no water meter bound **in the web portal**. Registration and login worked — the portal's billing API only returns 户号 bound *in its own system*, and an empty list means nothing is bound there yet. Bind one first:

1. Open the [web portal]({portal_url}) and sign in (phone number + password + SMS code)
2. Find 我的用水户 → 绑定其他户号 and enter the **户号** and **户名**, then follow the prompts
3. Come back here and press Submit to re-check — no need to sign in again

> ⚠️ A 户号 shown by the 中山公用水务 mobile app or 小程序 belongs to a **different front-end** and will not appear here until it is bound on the web as well.

bind_account.title: Bind a new account
bind_account.description:
Bind a water account that is not registered yet. Enter the account number, the account holder name and the phone number registered against the meter; the portal will text an SMS code to that number.

If binding fails here, bind it in the [web portal]({portal_url}) or in the 中山公用水务 WeChat account first, then use "Add bound accounts".
